description: This file contains ProseMirror-based table editing commands and event handlers, including keyboard navigation, paste handling, and mouse interactions within table cells for the Notesnook project.

methods.name: maybeSetSelection
methods.description: Sets the editor selection if it differs from the current one.

methods.name: arrow
methods.description: Handles arrow key navigation within table cells.

methods.name: shiftArrow
methods.description: Handles shift + arrow key navigation for cell selection.

methods.name: handleTripleClick
methods.description: Selects a table cell on triple click.

methods.name: handlePaste
methods.description: Handles paste events within table cells, inserting pasted content appropriately.

methods.name: handleMouseDown
methods.description: Handles mouse down events for cell selection and drag interactions.

methods.name: atEndOfCell
methods.description: Checks if the cursor is at the end of a cell in a given direction.

methods.name: domInCell
methods.description: Finds the table cell DOM element from a given node.

methods.name: cellUnderMouse
methods.description: Determines the table cell position under mouse coordinates.
